mission.title: Mindthus 246 live A/B/C host acceptance
mission.objective: Verify that A preserves its user-assigned goal, responsibility and acceptance while real ordinary B/C chats deliver, review and repair a bounded artifact

acceptance_evidence.description: Real B artifact repaired and independently reviewed against the fixed contract
Real host send, observed origin, return and deduplicated import facts are recorded with capability limits

A_responsibility: A preserves its user-assigned goal and owns design, evidence and final acceptance
